study_identification_part.si_4_title: A multimodal neural signature of face processing in autism within the fusiform gyrus

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "we leveraged the unique, large-scale and deeply phenotyped EU-AIMS Longitudinal European Autism Project 47,48 (LEAP)"

answer.LEAP: case-control multimodal sample used to derive normative-model deviation maps and subsequent LICA analyses

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Normative models trained across the entire LEAP sample (autistic + NAI) with 10-fold CV; multimodal analysis in FFG.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "Participants were part of the EU-AIMS/AIMS-2-TRIALS LEAP cohort"; "The final sample has both complete imaging data across four different imaging modalities and phenotypic information available consisting of 99 autistic (71 males, 28 females) and 105 NAI"; "Normative models were derived in an unbiased manner across the entire sample under tenfold cross-validation"

model-1.model-name: Unimodal normative models per modality (structure, rs-fMRI, task-fMRI, EEG; R/L FFG)

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: HC count reflects NAI in the LEAP sample; normative models were trained across the entire sample with 10-fold CV (not HC-only).
